My name is Niroshan, and I'm from Vancouver. I completed my undergraduate studies at SFU with a combined major in computing science and business. Towards the end of my degree, I started taking more data science courses, which were very interesting, so I decided to pursue the MDS program at UBC. I hope to eventually work as a product data scientist at Microsoft because I loved the office when I visited for a hackathon.
